subject.title: Slack: support assistant.threads.setSuggestedPrompts for dynamic prompt suggestions

question: Should OpenClaw add configurable and dynamic Slack assistant suggested prompts now, and should that be a Slack plugin config/action or an external plugin/portable Smart Replies path?
rationale: Current main has the Slack API primitive and fixed defaults, while the remaining request would add public config and agent-facing action behavior that repository policy treats as product and compatibility sensitive.

options.title: Design the API boundary first
options.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner decides the stable config and dynamic-action boundary before implementation.

options.title: Implement Slack-owned prompts
options.body: Add a Slack plugin config and optional action path with schema, docs, tests, and upgrade proof, accepting it as a Slack-specific public surface.

options.title: Route dynamic replies to plugins
options.body: Keep core fixed defaults and close only after maintainers explicitly decide that configurable or dynamic prompt behavior belongs in a ClawHub/plugin package.

recommendation.title: Design the API boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner decides the stable config and dynamic-action boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal on the Slack assistant lifecycle, setup manifest, and config/action surfaces that would define this API boundary.
